concerns.text: FR-003 (compute static features) and US-1 (Ground Truth Extraction) require merging ground truth labels with static features. Task T014 is marked incomplete and is the ONLY task covering this merge operation. Without T014, the dataset required for US-2 (T019) and US-3 (T027) cannot be generated, leaving FR-003 and US-1 partially unimplemented.

FR-007 (memory-efficient data loader) and Assumption A6 (7GB RAM limit) require a verified memory-efficient loader. Task T005 is marked incomplete and lacks the required unit test asserting peak memory < 7GB. Without T005, the foundation for all downstream tasks (T012, T019, T025) is unverified, violating the plan's critical path.

Constitution Principle VI (Static-Heuristic Falsifiability) and FR-009 require a performance drop threshold check. Task T031 (Falsifiability Check) depends on T031a (threshold config), but T031a is scheduled AFTER T031 and T030. This creates a logical gap where the falsifiability check cannot be performed as specified, leaving FR-009 and Constitution Principle VI unimplemented.

FR-008 (Learned Sparse baseline over 5 seeds) and FR-006 (paired t-test) require raw per-document scores for statistical pairing. Task T026a specifies saving per-document scores but does not explicitly guarantee the format or availability of the *exact* document-level pairing needed for the Wilcoxon/t-test logic in T029. This ambiguity risks leaving FR-006 and FR-008 untestable.

FR-003 requires computing 'local semantic density' as a static feature. Task T013 lists 'KenLM perplexity' and 'POS tags' but omits 'local semantic density' in its description. While T015 mentions edge cases, the specific implementation of 'local semantic density' is not explicitly covered by a task description or tag, creating a potential gap in FR-003 coverage.

Plan.md Phase 1 (Setup) requires project structure and linting. Tasks T001 (structure) and T003 (linting) are marked incomplete. While T002 (requirements) is complete, the missing verification artifacts (structure_verification.txt, .ruff.toml) mean the plan's Phase 1 deliverables are not fully covered by completed tasks.
